whatItDoes: Visual color picker with live <input type='color'>, HEX/RGB/HSL/HSV synced inputs, and palette generation (complementary, analogous ±30°, triadic 120°/240°). Shows conversions and copy buttons, all browser-native.
whyItExists: Designers and developers need to translate between color models and pick harmonious palettes without opening Figma. This does it instantly in the browser with no upload and one-click copy.
whoShouldUse: Frontend developers styling sites, designers picking palettes, and anyone converting a brand color between HEX/RGB/HSL.
useCases: Generate complementary and triadic palettes from a brand purple
Convert HSL 210 100% 50% to HEX for a design token
instructions: Pick a color via the color input or type HEX/RGB/HSL directly — all fields stay synced.
View conversions (HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV) and click Copy on any.
Choose a palette type to see complementary/analogous/triadic swatches and copy them.
No upload — all math is local.
bestPractices: Use HEX for CSS variables, HSL for tuning lightness/saturation
Check contrast with the Contrast Checker tool after picking
commonMistakes: Typing HEX without # — the field auto-adds it but copy includes #
Confusing HSL and HSV — they differ in lightness vs value; the tool shows both
faq: Does it need a server? No — color math is pure JS in your browser.
Can I pick from screen? Use Color Eyedropper for screen picking; this picker is for manual/typed colors.
Does it support alpha? Currently opaque only; alpha is on the roadmap.
